Hi Maya —

Thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. I put together a one-page MAP (attached as MAP_Medcraft_v1.xlsx) that reflects Redwood's standard sequencing for pilot engagements. Summary below — this is meant to be a pragmatic path to pilot while protecting both parties.

Proposed MAP (high level) — 4-week target to pilot kickoff:
1) Week 0–1: Security intake (Medcraft submits SOC2 snapshot + security questionnaire) — owner: Medcraft security (Samir) / Redwood security (Vanessa)
2) Week 1–2: Legal redlines (MSA master redlines + DPA review). Owner: Medcraft legal / Redwood legal. Goal: agree on commercial MSA; capture DPA changes in parallel.
3) Week 2: Commercial (order form draft, price & term confirmation). Owner: Medcraft procurement / Jordan (Redwood).
4) Week 2–3: Sign MSA + Order Form with data-use-limited terms for pilot OR sign MSA and execute an interim AUP (data-limited addendum) if DPA needs more time.
5) Week 3–4: Post-signing: DPA counter-signature and security evidence exchange; production onboarding.

Key policy notes: Redwood prefers to have an executed DPA in place before any production data is processed. For short pilots we can accept a limited data-use addendum that constrains scope until the DPA is finalized. If procurement requires an order form to release PO/payment, Jordan can support a conditional order form referencing the MAP and limited data conditions.

Next steps:
- Can Samir and legal@medcraft confirm SOC2 availability and whether procurement needs the PO before or after the order form is countersigned?
- If procurement needs an exact PO timeline, Jordan and I can draft a conditional order form and a minimal AUP to unblock pilot testing.

Link: HubSpot deal (DEAL-8473) in related links — I'll attach the MAP and PO template here as well.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee

Subject: Re: Crosswalk: MAP-driven MSA/DPA/Order Form sequencing for Medcraft

Hi all —

Appreciate the SOW and the MAP draft. A couple of practical points from Redwood Legal/Security perspective:
- DPA requirement: Redwood legal will need to confirm DPA terms before ingest of any customer PII. For a pilot that uses synthetic or anonymized data we can be flexible; if Medcraft expects to use live production data we will need the DPA signed prior to production access.
- Order form vs. PO timing: we often accept a signed order form as the commercial commitment and allow the procurement PO to follow for invoicing. If procurement cannot issue a PO until the invoice is attached to a fully executed order form, we recommend signing the MSA + order form together and closing the DPA concurrently.

Fallback options we can accept to keep the timeline tight:
- Limited Data Addendum (LDA): short addendum that restricts data classes and caps retention for the pilot. This lets the MSA+Order Form go live with constrained access while the full DPA is negotiated.
- Timebox: Redwood can agree to a 30-day pilot window with defined deletion/retention rules in the LDA.

If Medcraft is comfortable with an LDA for pilot activities, we can aim for the 4-week kickoff.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Security — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

P.S. attaching precedent language when I get sign-off from Legal (will share later today).

Subject: Internal: Commercial sequencing and concession plan (Medcraft)

Soojin — quick internal note (forwarding for context to Medcraft in my reply):
- Procurement ask: they want invoiceable milestone tied to a PO. We should propose: 1) execute MSA + Order Form for commercial terms, 2) invoice on PO receipt, 3) DPA execution tracked in MAP and required before production.
- Discount ask: Medcraft requested pilot pricing at 30% off list; recommend we offer 20% pilot credit with a commitment to review usage at the end of pilot for expansion.

I will draft a conditional order form referencing the MAP and an LDA option for the pilot. Priya, can you confirm whether Finance is ok with invoicing on PO receipt (standard) and the 20% pilot credit?

Thanks —

We can target pilot kickoff in 4 weeks if the above items move quickly. Sending PO template as an attachment (Medcraft_PO_template.pdf).

Cheers,
Maya
